answer: Receipts are committed as a hash and revealed one epoch later, so nothing can be rewritten after the audit. Edge case: a reveal that misses the deadline is slashed 25 percent even when the work is correct, because late reveals break the ordering assumption. Each claim is re-checked by a reviewer with no bond in the submitter's cluster. Example: 40 receipts, 3 late reveals, 3 slashes, none appealed. The cost spiral is the timing, not the fee. A cipher in a plume of boilerplate gets read line by line anyway.
